name: codec-worker-placement-armv7
reason: Counts behind the ARMv7 audio rows at 9d70b166, one c6g.4xlarge host (Graviton2) from the 32-bit ARMv7 gate image: perf stat user-mode instructions and cycles (5 runs, CPU 1) of the gate build of codec-worker at main 2a6a07a7 and at 9d70b166 on every non-AAC audio codec and file workload, with output digests; perf records with symbol reports of both on vorbis-q3-5.1; the script, the workers' SHA-256 and a bundle of the measured source; cited by docs/status.md for the multichannel audio rows, whose cycles moved with the placement of the unchanged IMDCT at equal instruction counts.
